notes.title: Update Patch 0.7.0.
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hey Cafe Owners![/b] 👋[/h1]

[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
    [*]🔼 Added a [b]Move Button[/b] to the [b]Farm[/b] — rearrange with ease!
    [*]📬 You can now [b]Visit Friends[/b] through [b]Postal Services[/b].

    [*]🏃‍♂️ [b]Staff Members[/b] now move [b]faster[/b]!

[b]For Streamers:[/b]
[list]
    [*]📢 [b]Streamer Bot[/b] and [b]StreamElements[/b] are now [b]officially supported[/b]!
